scripts.predev: [ -d node_modules ] || npm install; [ -d frontend/node_modules ] || npm install --prefix frontend; [ -d backend/node_modules ] || npm install --prefix backend; npm run db:start
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "npm run dev --prefix backend"
scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix backend && npm run db:start && npm run db:reset && npm run dev
scripts.test: npm run test --prefix frontend && npm run test --prefix backend
